pages.text:
## PSYCHIATRY CONSULTATION
Date: 08/17/2026 19:20
Consultant: Ingrid Halvorsen, MD (Psychiatry)
Reason: Positive suicide screen
## History
41M with long-standing untreated depression, worsened since losing housing. Reports low mood, poor sleep, hopelessness x 2 months.
## Suicide Risk Assessment
Patient endorses active suicidal ideation with a plan to overdose on pills he would buy after discharge. States intent is "maybe 50/50." No prior attempts. No firearms access.
Denies homicidal ideation. Denies auditory or visual hallucinations.
## Assessment
Major depressive disorder, single episode, severe, without psychotic features. High acute suicide risk.
## Plan
- Continue 1:1 sitter
- Start sertraline 50 mg PO daily
- Not psychiatrically stable for discharge to an unsupervised setting
- Recommend inpatient psychiatric admission once medically cleared
Signed: Ingrid Halvorsen, MD 08/17/2026 20:10
